title: Black Mountain College Summer Program 1943
credit_line: Black Mountain College Collection, gift of Barbara Beate Dreier and Theodore Dreier, Jr. on behalf of all generations of Dreier family
description: Mimeograph on paper with BMC letterhead. Description of the Summer Session. Information on fees, getting to campus (train times), climate (recommendation to bring a raincoat) and community life. Single sheet, printed on both sides
